outcome: Implement MADR 0002: a validated read-only raw_query step inside the canonical IR with placeholder-bound inputs, so long-tail analytical shapes run with the backend's provenance, idempotency and replay.
criteria: transform_dataset and materialize_result accept a raw_query step whose SQL references one or more inputs only through named placeholders, each resolved like any dataset reference and bound to a concrete version.

Validation parses the statement with DuckDB and accepts exactly one SELECT or WITH query. It refuses DDL, DML, ATTACH, COPY, LOAD, INSTALL, PRAGMA, SET, CALL, multiple statements, file or network table functions, replacement scans and physical table names, each with advice naming the accepted shape. Execution has no external access.

The output schema is derived with DESCRIBE before execution; the step is part of the operation record, idempotency fingerprint, explain output, lineage and model-free replay; responses carry used_raw_query.

Refusals and execution failures come back as structured results rather than protocol errors, previews stay within the existing preview limit, and an optional server-configured deadline stops a long raw_query with a structured error.

Tests on data unrelated to any benchmark cover a per-group window, a tie-aware extremum, a union of same-shaped datasets, a CTE, a multi-input join, every refusal class and idempotent replay, and the full suite including the boundary tests passes.
MADR 0002's history records the implementation and its status change, and a pull request against Intentum main states the behaviour, tradeoffs and remaining limitations.

dispositions.note: transform_dataset and materialize_result accept a raw_query first step. Its placeholders are bare table names that DuckDB's parser finds: input is the source, and each other name under inputs is resolved by the dataset resolver, with needs_resolution on ambiguity. The IR records each binding as a versioned DatasetRef.

Validation uses extract_statements and json_serialize_sql and accepts one SELECT or WITH. It refuses DDL, DML, ATTACH, COPY, LOAD, INSTALL, PRAGMA, SET, CALL, multiple statements, file, network and non-allowlisted table functions, replacement scans and storage names, as well as qualified names, parameters, CTE shadowing and unused inputs. Each refusal carries raw_query advice. The statement runs on a sandbox connection with external access, extension autoload and install and community extensions off, and its configuration locked. Probes with read_csv, FROM a file, read_text, glob, query(), duckdb_settings, getenv, COPY, ATTACH, PRAGMA, INSTALL, SET, a second statement, a storage name, a qualified name, a shadowing CTE, a LATERAL read_csv and read_parquet over https were all refused.

DESCRIBE runs over the placeholder schemas before execution and again over the real inputs. The step is part of the canonical IR, the logical fingerprint (SQL text and bound versions), explain, lineage (every bound input as derived_from) and replay. used_raw_query appears on transform, materialize and replay responses, in explain, get_operation and get_provenance.

Refusals and failures come back as structured INVALID_TRANSFORM or EXECUTION_FAILED results, and MCP isError stays false. Previews respect preview_limit. Backend(query_timeout), --query-timeout or AGENT_BACKEND_QUERY_TIMEOUT interrupts the sandbox connection with a recoverable EXECUTION_FAILED; the test stops a cross join in under a second.

tests/test_raw_query.py adds 73 tests on shop data. They cover windows and QUALIFY, ties at a maximum, UNION ALL, a CTE, a two-input join, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, CASE, LIKE, regexp, PIVOT IN, a recursive CTE, 38 refusal cases, the executed rewrites, replay, lineage, explain, the deadline and MCP. The full suite passes: 355 tests, test_boundary and test_mcp unchanged. agent_backend contains no scenario words.

MADR 0002 moves from proposed to accepted, with a history entry for this outcome. Pull request https://github.com/rowan-hiro/Intentum/pull/2 against main states the behaviour, design choices, tradeoffs and remaining limitations, using general motivation only.

note: A subagent in this session implemented raw_query; I reviewed it file by file and probed it adversarially. The implementation is commit ef5a93f on feat/raw-query. The user will have the PR reviewed by another model. Intentum-DataSpace adopts it in F2 after the merge. Known limits are listed in the PR: non-deterministic SQL is not refused, the sandbox has no memory or disk quota, inputs are copied on every execution, and a raw_query must read its source.
